job.title: Senior SRE, Site Experience
job.pay_full: $190,800 – $267,100 a year base salary, plus equity in restricted stock units

details.about: Reddit is a community of communities, with more than 100,000 active communities and about 130 million daily active unique visitors. The Site Experience SRE team sits where infrastructure, product engineering and user experience meet, keeping every interaction across web, mobile, APIs, feeds, media delivery and real-time systems fast, reliable and resilient. This Senior Site Reliability Engineer leads reliability work for critical user-facing systems at internet scale.
duties: Lead projects that improve reliability, scalability and performance of user-facing systems, from design through launch across APIs, content delivery, feed generation, search and real-time experiences
Work with product and infrastructure teams on redundancy, graceful degradation, traffic management and capacity planning
Find systemic risks and reliability bottlenecks and drive improvements that reduce incidents
Automate repetitive operational work and build tooling for deployment safety, incident response and reliability guardrails
Define and champion standards for SLIs/SLOs, capacity management, release engineering and operational maturity
Mentor engineers across SRE and software engineering
needs: 5+ years in Site Reliability Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering or related roles running large-scale distributed systems
Strong experience supporting high-traffic, user-facing production environments
Deep understanding of one or more of: distributed systems, networking, Linux systems, cloud-native architectures
Strong programming skills in Go, Python or similar
Strong understanding of observability: metrics, logging, tracing and alerting
Experience improving reliability through SLOs, automation, incident management and performance optimization
Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across applications, infrastructure, networking and services, and to influence technical direction across teams
nice: Kubernetes, containers, cloud infrastructure and modern deployment platforms
Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Envoy, Kafka, ClickHouse, Cassandra, Redis or similar
CDN optimization, edge reliability, traffic engineering or global infrastructure
Open-source contributions; leading large-scale incident response
details.benefits: Base salary $190,800 – $267,100 a year (the posting may span more than one career level); the role is also eligible for equity in restricted stock units. Benefits include comprehensive healthcare and income replacement programs, a 401(k) with employer match, family planning support, mental health and coaching benefits, flexible vacation and paid volunteer time off, and generous paid parental leave.
notes: Fully remote within the United States
The posting may span more than one career level
Interviews for some roles may be recorded and transcribed; candidates can opt out beforehand
